title: Bayesian safety signal detection with bssd
text: study drug placebo randomized ratio \(k:1\). prior distribution placebo parameters based historical placebo data event rate \(\lambda_{HP}\) total patient time \(PT_{HP}\), discounted factor \(DF\). BDRIBS. number subjects event blinded data, \(Y\), follows \[Y \sim \mathrm{Poisson}\{E \delta (r k + 1) / (k + 1)\},\] \(E\) exposure, \(\delta\) event rate placebo \(r\) rate ratio study drug placebo. priors \(\delta \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(\lambda_{HP} PT_{HP} / DF, PT_{HP} / DF)\) shape rate parameters, \(r = p / \{k (1 - p)\}\) \(p \sim \mathrm{Beta}(, b)\). BDRIBS(1) uses total exposure time \(E\). BDRIBS(2) uses total time risk, leaves time first occurrence event. computed time_at_risk(). EXP_BERN. Subject \(\) follow-time \(t_i\) event (\(Y_i = 1\)) probability \[P(Y_i = 1) = w_p \{1 - \exp(-\lambda_p t_i)\} + w_d \{1 - \exp(-r \lambda_p t_i)\},\] \(w_p = 1 / (k + 1)\) \(w_d = k / (k + 1)\). priors \(\lambda_p\) \(r\) \(\delta\) \(r\) BDRIBS. LL_BERN. exponential distribution replaced log-logistic distribution, \[P(Y_i = 1) = w_p F(t_i; \mu_p, \sigma_p) + w_d F(t_i; \mu_d, \sigma_d), \quad F(t; \mu, \sigma) = 1 - \frac{1}{1 + \exp\{(\log t - \mu) / \sigma\}},\] hazard can change time (ll_cdf()). relative risk ratio cumulative incidences time \(t^*\), \(RR(t^*) = F(t^*; \mu_d, \sigma_d) / F(t^*; \mu_p, \sigma_p)\). Duncan (2026) state relative risk used model. ?llbern_post describes choice priors. signal declared posterior probability relative risk exceeds critical value \(rr_0\) larger threshold, \(P(RR > rr_0 \mid \mathrm{data}) > \mathrm{cutoff}\). defaults \(rr_0 = 1\) \(\mathrm{cutoff} = 0.95\).

title: LL_BERN: log-logistic Bernoulli mixture model
text: log-logistic Bernoulli (LL_BERN) model Duncan (2026, Section 3.4) replaces exponential distribution EXP_BERN (vignette("expbern")) log-logistic distribution, hazard event can change time. subject \(\) follow-time \(t_i\), event indicator \(Y_i\) follows \[P(Y_i = 1) = w_p F(t_i; \mu_p, \sigma_p) + w_d F(t_i; \mu_d, \sigma_d), \quad F(t; \mu, \sigma) = 1 - \frac{1}{1 + \exp\{(\log t - \mu) / \sigma\}},\] \(w_p = 1 / (k + 1)\) \(w_d = k / (k + 1)\) randomization ratio \(k:1\), \((\mu_p, \sigma_p)\) \((\mu_d, \sigma_d)\) location scale parameters placebo study drug. hazard decreasing \(\sigma \ge 1\) first increases decreases \(\sigma < 1\). values \(\mu\) \(\sigma\) estimated historical placebo data, priors \[\mu_p \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(PT_{HP} \mu / DF_p, PT_{HP} / DF_p), \quad \sigma_p \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(PT_{HP} \sigma / DF_p, PT_{HP} / DF_p),\] \[\mu_d \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(\mu, 1), \quad \sigma_d \sim \mathrm{Gamma}(\sigma, 1),\] shape rate parameterization. priors placebo parameters means \(\mu\) \(\sigma\), \(PT_{HP} / DF_p\) sets precision; priors study drug parameters weakly informative. Duncan (2026) state relative risk used signal criterion model. bssd uses ratio cumulative incidences time \(t^*\), \[RR(t^*) = F(t^*; \mu_d, \sigma_d) / F(t^*; \mu_p, \sigma_p),\] declares signal \(P\{RR(t^*) > \theta_c \mid \mathrm{data}\} > P_{\mathrm{cutoff}}\). arguments llbern_post() correspond symbols follows. parameters \(\mu\) \(\sigma\) refer time unit t t_star. ll_cdf() computes \(F(t; \mu, \sigma)\), ll_mu() gives location parameter cumulative incidence given time.
